label: Agriculture / Food Security
summary: Fields and crops from satellite imagery: vegetation and moisture indices, seasonal change and management zones.
guidance: Prioritize fields, crop/soil conditions, vegetation indices, irrigation, seasonal comparisons, yield proxies, and uncertainty in remote-sensing interpretation.

readiness.capability: Sentinel-2 scene search and band download for an area
NDVI, NDWI, NDRE and SAVI, EVI, NDMI, NBR, MNDWI, BSI
field report layout (index readings with dates and units, a reading guide, and a note that they are not a yield or rate recommendation)
index class and management-zone looks drawn on a raster (the class ranges, units and 3 to 5 zone legend text exist and are tested; nothing paints them yet)
readiness.since: after R3-6 (needs a discrete colour shader)

readiness.reason: not recommended without ground truth; the plugin gives indices and zones, not yield or rate recommendations

guardrails: Indices describe vegetation and moisture, not yield; say so.
Never recommend an input rate or a yield from imagery alone.
Cloud cover and the acquisition date go in every statement about a scene.
